title: Poisoning Self-Evolving Security Policies in LLM Agents
title_zh: LLM 智能体的自演化安全策略投毒
abstract_en: Self-evolving defenses improve LLM-agent security by learning reusable policies from observed attacks. However, we demonstrate that this learning process itself can become an attack surface. Using SED (Self-Evolving Defense) in the AgentDojo benchmark, we construct a single prompt-injection episode that causes the defense to learn an over-broad policy and subsequently refuse legitimate requests. Across 10 Nemotron runs, every poisoned run over-refuses at least one legitimate task, while unrelated-task performance remains unchanged and the original prompt-injection defense remains effective. The attack also transfers to gpt-oss-120b; however, its poisoning mechanism depends on a successful initial prompt injection and therefore fails to activate when the target agent resists the underlying injection. In contrast, integrity-oriented attacks targeting SED's judge, policy synthesis, retrieval, and organization mechanisms fail in our evaluated settings, identifying over-refusal as the primary exploitable failure mode observed in our experiments. We further identify self-poisoning from false-positive harm judgments without an attacker. Finally, contrastive policy synthesis and an automatic broadness-check gate substantially reduce, but do not eliminate over-refusal, without compromising security in our evaluated settings.
abstract_zh: 自演化防御通过从已观测到的攻击中学习可复用的策略来提升 LLM 智能体的安全性，但学习过程本身也可能成为攻击面。作者在 AgentDojo 上评估 Self-Evolving Defense（SED），发现一次成功的提示注入（prompt injection）就可能使 SED 学到适用范围过广的策略，进而拒绝后续合法请求。Nemotron 的 10 次投毒实验均出现至少一项合法任务被误拒，但无关任务的表现未变，原有的提示注入防御仍然有效。这一现象也出现在 gpt-oss-120b 上，但如果智能体抵御了初始提示注入，投毒机制就不会触发。在所测设置中，针对 SED 判定、策略合成、检索和组织环节的完整性攻击均未成功，过度拒绝是实验中观察到的主要可利用失效模式。即使没有攻击者，系统也可能因误将无害行为判为有害而发生自投毒。对比式策略合成（contrastive policy synthesis）和自动策略范围检查（broadness-check gate）显著减少了过度拒绝，但未将其消除；在所测设置中，两项措施均未削弱安全性。
key_points_zh: Nemotron 的 10 次投毒实验均出现合法任务被误拒，但无关任务表现和原有防御效果不变。
投毒现象可迁移至 gpt-oss-120b，但前提是初始提示注入成功。
所测完整性攻击均未成功；即使没有攻击者，有害性误判也可能导致自投毒。
对比式策略合成和自动策略范围检查显著减少了过度拒绝，但未将其消除，也未削弱所测设置下的安全性。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 论文直接评估工具型文本代理如何从运行轨迹更新可复用安全策略，并在策略写入前加入范围检查门，验证候选策略是否误拒合法请求。两种模型的受控对照显示，缓解措施在所测条件下维持原有防御效果并部分恢复合法任务成功率，但相对收益因模型而异。研究仅覆盖一种防御架构；检查门本身不会随反馈改进，因此不标记 RSI。
agent-harness-evolution.quote: Our gate intervenes at policy-write time, after SED’s synthesizer proposes a rule but before the rule is saved to memory.
agent-harness-evolution.result_quote:
Adding a Membrane-style matched benign counterexample raises success to 82%, while our
automatic broadness-check gate reaches 88%.
